fusions.name: Dawn Report
fusions.desc: Fires a shot that deals 30 damage to the first enemy it meets and is always a critical hit. You move 25% faster for 4 seconds after firing.

fusions.name: Clean Finish
fusions.desc: Takes a shot at a target at or below 25% health, dealing 20 damage and adding 1.2 times the remaining damage of every affliction on it. The health threshold rises with each rank.

fusions.name: Burst From Cover
fusions.desc: Bursts you 5 tiles forward. You move 25% faster for 4 seconds after it.

fusions.name: Reed-Blind Vigil
fusions.desc: After 8 seconds without a critical hit, your critical hit chance rises by 40% for your next strike. Once every 8 seconds.
